name: com.kazukikuriyama.maplibre-unity
description: MapLibre GL JS port for Unity, written in pure C# with no native plugins. Renders raster and vector tiles with full MapLibre Style Spec support (paint/layout properties, expressions, zoom functions, filters, symbols, camera animations).

samples.description: Every demo scene grouped under HomeScene — basic raster, vector with labels, terrain, fill-extrusion, glyph URL SDF text, custom layers/sources, camera animations, feature-state, marker/popup, and more (38 scenes total). Add the imported scenes to Build Settings to run them.
